This program aims to help these institutions secure their open-source software without needing disruptive upgrades or sharing proprietary code. Lightwell, launched with a $5 billion commitment, identifies, validates, and remediates vulnerabilities, contributing fixes back to the open-source communities.

events.title: Applied Optoelectronics Stock Climbs on EML Shortage Immunity Before Q2 Report
events.summary: Applied Optoelectronics (AAOI) stock surged due to its unique Molecular Beam Epitaxy (MBE) laser manufacturing technology, which makes it immune to the EML laser shortage affecting rivals. This allows AAOI to continue producing transceivers for AI data centers, unlike competitors whose EML supply has been locked up by Nvidia. The company is accelerating manufacturing capacity in Texas and will report Q2 2026 earnings soon, with investors watching for revenue, gross margin, and future production guidance.

events.title: Amazon faces suit alleging it forces poor pay, conditions on drivers
events.summary: New Jersey has sued Amazon.com Inc., accusing the online retailer of abusing its market power to impose low pay and poor working conditions on independent delivery drivers within the state through its Delivery Service Partner program. The state alleges Amazon punishes drivers who attempt to unionize and restricts businesses in the program from poaching each other's drivers, violating antitrust law. Amazon denies the claims, stating that the allegations are not grounded in fact and that DSPs manage their drivers' workdays, with employees free to choose their employers.

events.title: How executives with international experience are giving grocers a critical edge
events.summary: Grocery chains in the U.S. are increasingly hiring top-level executives with international experience, a trend exemplified by Kroger's CEO Greg Foran. events.title: Kroger Announces Store Closures as Retail Giant Resets Following Failed Albertsons Merger
events.summary: Kroger announced plans to close approximately 60 underperforming supermarkets across the United States, less than a year after its proposed merger with Albertsons failed. This restructuring marks a strategic shift towards improving operational efficiency, modernizing existing stores, and strengthening digital capabilities, moving away from expansion for expansion's sake. The decision reflects broader industry trends where retailers prioritize productivity, technology, customer experience, and profitability over the sheer number of stores, especially given intense competition from other major retailers.

events.title: Honda Introduces New Amazon Storefront in U.S. for Power Equipment Products
events.summary: American Honda Motor Co., Inc. has launched a new Amazon storefront for its Power Equipment products in the U.S., aiming to expand customer access and enhance the online shopping experience. This new digital store will feature a curated selection of products like generators and lawn mowers, with fulfillment handled by Honda's authorized dealer network to ensure continued quality service and support. The initiative integrates Honda's dealers into the Amazon process, maintaining the brand's reputation for reliability and customer care, while providing comprehensive product information and educational content.

events.summary: Chipotle is replacing jalapeños in some of its restaurants after a salmonella outbreak in Minnesota sickened approximately 110 people, with 75 of those affected having eaten at the fast-food chain. The company stated that the contaminated jalapeños were distributed to multiple food service retailers across several states. This incident follows a recent cyclospora outbreak tied to other fast-food chains, causing Chipotle's stock to tumble 10% on Tuesday.
